ideas.title: Minnesota Daycare Fraud: A Large-Scale Sting Operation
ideas.description: Investigate the Minnesota daycare fraud probe and James O'Keefe's sting operation that found potential for zero arrests.
ideas.angle: In-depth look at the fraud investigation and its potential outcomes
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
Why may there be zero arrests?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and potential lack of accountability.

ideas.title: The Impact of Hudson Tunnel Funding Freeze on Taxpayers
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of the $16 billion funding freeze for the Hudson Tunnel project on taxpayers in New York and New Jersey.
ideas.angle: Analysis of the financial implications of the funding freeze
ideas.insight: This story could reveal the significant financial burden on taxpayers due to the funding freeze.
